scope: Diagnostic/algebra evidence only; no physical acceptance or production adoption
protocol:
Predeclared offline residual audit; no shader changes or new capture. Use original120step hip trace plus same-run phase capture (byte-identical body streams). Evaluate all39active joints at final relaxation phase21 velocities, current end geometry and recorded impulse caches, using prepared step-start inertia and the exact pass-specific bias/softness rules. Verify final published velocities against phase23. Saved joint caches must not be changed by restitution/finalization (source check).
For each independent row/block evaluate a hypothetical isolated minimization from the actual final-pass state: residual w+b+Gamma*lambda; bilateral exact Newton step, scalar unilateral/box projected solution, spherical motor torque-ball constrained metric solution. Report remaining quadratic-objective decrease (nonnegative), not physical energy produced. Row gaps cannot be summed as a global energy/error bound because rows are coupled. Report raw residual units as well. Bias-free point/hinge alignment and violated angular limits have Gamma=0 on relaxation; springs retain bias/Gamma. Speculative unviolated limits retain separation/h bias.
Also evaluate how an isolated exact point correction changes the same joint's angular residual gaps with all angular caches fixed. This is a counterfactual coupling test, not an actual extra GPU pass or proof of a global fix. All120frames,4680joint observations, finite outputs, phase/body/schema/identity checks mandatory. No thresholds for physical acceptance are replaced; no candidate judged using this diagnostic alone. Conclusions must determine next solver work, not launch another general instrumentation campaign.
